dataflow.heading: Data flow
dataflow.step1: Audio from the recorder, the browser or an upload goes to the company's own Cloudflare account. R2 stores it with EU jurisdiction, and the upload sessions are Durable Objects with jurisdiction eu. Neither needs Enterprise.
dataflow.step2: {provider} receives audio and keyterms directly at its EU endpoint, not through AI Gateway, which does not support it. It returns text and speakers.
dataflow.step2WorkersAi: {provider} runs on Workers AI in the company's own Cloudflare account. Audio and keyterms go to it through AI Gateway. It returns text without speakers.
dataflow.step2WorkersAiDirect: {provider} runs on Workers AI in the company's own Cloudflare account. No AI Gateway ID is set, so audio and keyterms go to it directly. It returns text without speakers.
dataflow.step2ElevenLabs: {provider} receives audio and keyterms through AI Gateway in the company's Cloudflare account. It returns text and speakers. On a self-serve ElevenLabs plan, ElevenLabs processes the audio in the US and keeps it in its request history; EU residency and zero retention are Enterprise-only.
dataflow.step2ElevenLabsDirect: No AI Gateway ID is set, so {provider} receives audio and keyterms directly. It returns text and speakers. On a self-serve ElevenLabs plan, ElevenLabs processes the audio in the US and keeps it in its request history; EU residency and zero retention are Enterprise-only.
dataflow.step2Unavailable: {provider} is not available in this version, so no audio goes to it. Choose a provider this version transcribes with.
dataflow.step2None: No speech-to-text provider is chosen yet. Audio is stored, and transcription waits until one is chosen.
dataflow.step3: {provider} writes the recap from the transcript, and the requests go through AI Gateway. Meeting data is stored in D1.
dataflow.step3Direct: {provider} writes the recap from the transcript. No AI Gateway ID is set, so the requests go to {provider} directly. Meeting data is stored in D1.
dataflow.step4: Audio is deleted after {audioDays, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Transcripts and recaps are deleted after {textDays, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Keep prevents both deletions.
dataflow.promise: Processing is not guaranteed to stay in the EU.
dataflow.caveats: The install tooling creates the D1 database and the queues with EU jurisdiction. Worker placement is best effort, normally at the data centre nearest the request; regional restrictions require the Enterprise-only Data Localization Suite. Workers AI and AI Gateway are not covered by Regional Services.
dataflow.local: A local live transcript stays on the computer and is discarded when the meeting ends. After the server confirms a recording, the recorder keeps the audio locally for 7 days. Without a confirmation it keeps the file and retries.
